motion.effect: Smooth sliding transform via CSS :has() selector on the pseudo-element indicator to create Apple Liquid Glass aesthetic.

instructions_to_main_agent: Completely overwrite the existing styles for `.lang-switch`, `.lang-opt`, and `.lang-switch--menu`.
Remove the old `.lang-switch svg { width: 10px; height: 10px; }` and old `gap: 10px;` to allow the pill indicator to work correctly.
Use `:has()` selector in CSS to control a `::before` pseudo-element on `.lang-switch`. This pseudo-element serves as the sliding Apple iOS glass indicator.

For the indicator logic: `.lang-switch::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 4px; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; width: calc(50% - 4px); ... }`. Then use `.lang-switch:has(.lang-opt:nth-child(2).is-active)::before { transform: translateX(100%); }` (and similarly for `[aria-current='page']`).

IMPORTANT: In the `@media (max-width: 900px)` query, remove the `display: none;` on `.lang-opt span`. The user explicitly requested 'TR' and 'EN' text to remain side-by-side on mobile. Add `.lang-opt span { display: inline !important; }` to guarantee visibility.
Keep `.is-active` logic strictly CSS-based. Do NOT implement any JS event listeners for the toggle (user requested keeping native links and no-JS functionality intact).

If the HTML needs Turkish (🇹🇷) and UK (🇬🇧) flag emojis or SVGs, apply the dimensions using the new `.lang-flag` class (`width: 16px; height: 11px; flex-shrink: 0; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)`).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing. Ensure all CSS relies on native CSS features without Javascript fallbacks. Do NOT use green/teal (#3f6b4a etc) for the language switch per user instruction. Maintain strict Apple Liquid Glass premium aesthetic.
